trans-unit.source: Displays popup messages on events such as achievement unlocks and game completion.
trans-unit.target: Visar popupmeddelanden när en prestation låses upp eller ett spel slutförs.

trans-unit.source: Displays popup messages when starting, submitting, or failing a leaderboard challenge.
trans-unit.target: Visar popupmeddelanden när en topplisteutmaning startas, skickas in eller misslyckas.

trans-unit.source: Customize the sound effect that are played whenever you received a notification, earned an achievement or submitted an entry to the leaderboard.
trans-unit.target: Anpassa ljudeffekten som spelas upp när du får en avisering, låser upp en prestation eller skickar in ett resultat till topplistan.
